solve_lqr_optimal_policy: solve the discrete-time LQR problem and return the optimal value function Hessian, linear policy gain matrix, and convergence rate
compute_state_transition_matrix: compute the state transition matrix a from the mass, stiffness, and damping matrices of a MuJoCo physics model
compute_control_transition_matrix: compute the control transition matrix b from the mass matrix and number of controls in the environment
solve_discrete_algebraic_riccati: solve the discrete algebraic Riccati equation using scipy to find the optimal cost-to-go Hessian matrix p
check_system_stability: check if the controlled system is stable by verifying the maximum eigenvalue of the closed-loop matrix is less than 1.0
